csv_scope_of_work: The City of Summerville, Ga is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified aquatic recreation and splash pad design-build firms for the construction of a new 3,464 square foot sports-themed splash pad facility featuring durable poly-coated FunForm play elements and a modern flow-through water management system configuration. The pad shall be round and consist of a reinforced concrete slab with a slip-resistent broom-finish and UV-stable polyurea safety coating to reduce falls. The selected contractor shall provide turnkey services including design, engineering, equipment procurement, site preparation, excavation, installation, and commissioning of an engaging, family-oriented aquatic play environment that promotes recreation, safety, ADA accessibility, and long-term operational efficiency. The project is intended to create a visually appealing destination attraction incorporating interactive sports-inspired spray features, themed components, and high-quality recreational amenities suitable for users of all ages.
